plain_english: Heaven-made, hell-made — this person between bodies; when that breaks, by fitness joining another body.
sanskrit_cite: svargamayo nirayamayas tad ayaṃ dehāntarālagaḥ puruṣaḥ | tadbhaṅge svaucityād dehāntarayogam abhyeti

plain_english: As in knowing-time the self once shone for him, so then — on body-falling, otherwise it does not become.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ jñānāvasare svātmā sakṛd asya yādṛg avabhātaḥ | tādṛśa eva tadāsau na dehapāte 'nyathā bhavati

plain_english: Senses stolen, memory lost, breath choked, cut off, vitals pained — enjoyment born of body-impressions.
sanskrit_cite: karaṇagaṇasaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtināśaḥ śvāsakalilatā cchedaḥ | marmasu rujāviśeṣāḥ śarīrasaṃskārajo bhogaḥ

plain_english: How could he, being embodied, not be so? By that, deluded though — at death-time the knower falls not from self-truth.
sanskrit_cite: sa kathaṃ vigrahayoge sati na bhavet tena mohayoge 'pi | maraṇāvasare jñāni na cyavate svātmaparamārthāt

plain_english: This truth-path, quickly, when gained from the teacher's mouth — by keenest grace-fall, then indeed, unblocked, Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: paramārthamārgam enaṃ jhaṭiti yadā gurumukhāt samabhyeti | atitīvraśaktipātāt tadaiva nirvighnam eva śivaḥ

plain_english: All-crossed form, by steps resorted, on gaining root in supreme truth — at the end, Śiva-madeness.
sanskrit_cite: sarvottīrṇaṃ rūpaṃ sopānapadakrameṇa saṃśrayataḥ | paratattvarūḍhilābhe paryante śivamayībhāvaḥ

plain_english: But his truth-made stream, unreached, middle-rested — though mind yearns for that step, death may sometime come.
sanskrit_cite: tasya tu paramārthamayīṃ dhārām agatasya madhyaviśrānteḥ | tatpadalābhotsukacetaso 'pi maraṇaṃ kadācit syāt

plain_english: Fallen from yoga, the books call him wonder-enjoyment-world-lord; rested by stage-power, become, in next birth Śiva-becoming.
sanskrit_cite: yogabhraṣṭaḥ śāstre kathito 'sau citrabhogabhuvanapatiḥ | viśrāntisthānavaśād bhūtvā janmāntare śivībhavati

plain_english: Practising this truth-path, missing yoga though, by name — god-world-pleasure-sharer, glad-minded, rejoices long.
sanskrit_cite: paramārthamārgam enaṃ hy abhyasyāprāpya yogam api nāma | suralokabhogabhāgī muditamanā modate suciram
